newsitem.title: CANADA: Martin sees Canada unemployment back under 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Martin sees Canada unemployment back under 10 pct.

text.p: Canadian Finance Minister Paul Martin predicted on Friday that Canada's unemployment rate would head back under 10 percent.
Noting it had been under 10 percent for most of the past 1-1/2 years, Martin told reporters: "It's going to go back below double digits."
Unemployment shot up to 10.0 percent in June and then again in October. November's data were to be released at 0700 EST/1200 GMT on December 6.
Asked about data showing third-quarter real growth in gross domestic product of 0.8 percent, Martin said: "The growth figures show the recovery is well anchored."
